# John Violette
## John Violette
### Signature
**John Mark Violette** is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked at [Mattel](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Mattel "Mattel") from 2006 to 2011.
He was responsible for the [Ferrari Racer](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Ferrari_Racer "Ferrari Racer") , [Crashers](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Crashers_(2007) "Crashers (2007)") , [Color Shifters](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Color_Shifters "Color Shifters") and [Custom Motors](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Custom_Motors "Custom Motors") series as well as several new castings.
He currently runs his own design firm, John Violette Design LLC; prior to this, he was a concept designer at competing brand Spin Master.
